supporting_observations.claim: The repeated HTTPS tunnel activity went to update.routewise.com, the approved RouteWise update endpoint; observed checks occurred from 13:38:37 through 14:08:08 at roughly five-minute intervals.

Endpoint telemetry associates these connections with C:\Program Files\RouteWise\routewiseupd.exe, the inventoried updater, including its outbound connections at 13:38:37, 13:42:56, 13:48:00, 13:53:10, 13:57:48, 14:03:39, and 14:08:08.

The observed endpoint, destination, and approximate cadence match the approved RouteWise updater behavior described in the inventory; the alerted periodic connections are therefore more consistent with routine update checks than malicious outbound activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels and byte counts, not the encrypted application payload or the content returned by the destination (for example, T136-00125 and T136-00152).

The RouteWise process was launched with Firefox as its parent, and the proxy records report a Firefox user agent; the records do not establish why it was launched or whether that user-agent value is expected for this updater (T136-00122, T136-00123, T136-00125, T136-00126).
The supplied records show RouteWise connections beginning at 13:38:37; they do not independently document RouteWise checks from 13:30 to that time (T136-00122, T136-00125).
claims_not_established: The records do not establish the RouteWise executable's signature, hash, or integrity.
The records do not establish what initiated the updater process or what content was exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-KNGUYEN-01 connected to desktop.dropbox.com with a DropboxUpdate user agent; Dropbox is not an approved file-sharing or cloud-storage service in the supplied inventory (T136-00254, T136-00255).

Separate review: WS-KNGUYEN-01 ran DBeaver and PostgreSQL psql and made PostgreSQL connections to internal hosts; the supplied inventory does not describe these database services or their authorization (T136-00034, T136-00035, T136-00063, T136-00111, T136-00114, T136-00118).
